definitions.grouped: Sort scores ascending; aggregate equal scores or transformed bin IDs; accept whole blocks; integrate right steps.
definitions.secondary: Existing weighted_risk_coverage; independent saved secondary keys order exact score ties; same right-step rule.
definitions.auroc_ap: True-score ties grouped for raw scores, including raw_secondary; transformed-score ties grouped for binned scores.
definitions.weights: Identical saved QA samples and inverse inclusion weights within each comparison.
definitions.group_macro: Arithmetic mean of the per-family metrics; neither pooled pixel metrics nor a confidence interval.

limitations: Post-hoc sampled diagnostics; do not replace the frozen full-population primary endpoint.
Pooling Night combines group composition and potentially different fold-specific score scales; differences cannot be attributed solely to one factor.
Whole-block curves may miss requested coverages when scores tie; actual coverages are reported.
Three Night filename families are not three proven independent sessions.
No fitting, model selection, neural-network forward pass, or probability tensor storage.
additional_diagnostic: Exact-score grouped AUROC decomposed into within-family and cross-family positive/negative pairs using the same saved inverse-inclusion-weighted Night QA population.
